stories.title: Oldcircle/geo-sleuth
stories.reason: geo-sleuth: an agent skill that geolocates photos with no GPS/EXIF using shadow geometry, elevation-skyline matching, CLIP satellite scoring and DINOv2/SIFT street-view matching — real running code with documented cases (errors of ~2m, 87m, 3m), not a paper. Fits the 'running code beats a description' weighting note.
key_facts: Techniques: shadow/sun bearing estimation, pier-spacing distance ruler, elevation skyline matching, OSM queries, CLIP satellite scoring, DINOv2/SIFT street-view matching
3 documented demo cases with reported position errors of ~2m, 87m, 3m
Author notes the blind re-runs are regression checks on photos the skill was tuned on, not an unseen-photo benchmark
